title: Photorealistic architectural 3D miniature diorama of a futuristic metropolitan city during light overcast rain and controlled shallow street flooding. In the visual composition matching Axle Journey: centered in the midground is a wide modern civic emergency command center with an aerodynamic curved roof canopy, glowing warm amber interior glass concourse, and subtle orange emergency beacon. In the foreground are wet reflective dark asphalt boulevards with standing puddles mirroring overcast gray clouds, miniature trees, sleek white electric relief supply vans and rail shuttles with subtle orange accents, and glowing cyan-green routing lines on the road. In the background is a dense cinematic modern skyline disappearing into soft atmospheric haze. Realistic scale, tilt-shift miniature city depth of field, premium architectural visualization, 8k resolution, elegant mood, no UI text.
